violations.msg: AMS1117 output cap C5 is 10uF X5R ceramic (~6-8uF effective at 3.3V bias, ESR ~5 mOhm) but the C6186 datasheet makes COUT part of the frequency compensation and states stability only for 22uF solid tantalum, so the board's only rail can oscillate and cause erratic resets/SWD flakiness at bring-up.

VDDA (U1 pin 9) is decoupled with a single 100nF vs the unconditional DS5319 requirement of 1uF//10nF (Fig 40/5.3.18); VDDA also feeds the PLL/HSI so filtering margin is eroded - tolerable for a blinky, mandatory to fix before any ADC use.

No 4.7uF bulk capacitor at VDD_3 (pin 48) despite the DS5319 5.1.6 caution 'the 4.7uF capacitor must be connected to VDD3'; the substitute (C5 at the LDO) is remote and is itself the cap flagged in the ldo-cout-stability error.

Library symbols type nearly every pin 'passive' (all U1 GPIOs/NRST/BOOT0/OSC pins, headers, diodes, crystal), so the green ERC 0/0 gate could not have caught driver conflicts, floating driven inputs, or signal-to-rail shorts - machine coverage is vacuous and future boards from these symbols are unguarded.
